description: One armed work item's row, as written by the workbench harness writer (lib/progress/attention.py render_row) and consumed by the evaluator's ingest. Serialized sorted-keys, indent 2, trailing newline; written atomically (.tmp sibling + os.replace).

handle.description: The todo's name (its slug id); the harness records no posting lane and never guesses one.

project.description: The todo's project slug (same value as programme).

source_class.description: fixture rows never supervise (consumer-side exclusion, contract 03).

todo.description: The todo's name — its slug id (contract 11 WR1).

title: Attention armed row (wb-armed-<project-slug>-<todo-name>.json)
